notes.title: New patch and 50% off!
notes.content:
Hello, friends!

We're proud to present a new patch for [b]Mad Nords: Probably an Epic Quest[/b]! So what have changed you might ask? Here you go:
[list]
[*] completely rebalanced nyctomancer's skills
[*] fixed reward in the "It's Alive!" quest
[*] and as always bunch of minor bug fixes and spelling corrections
[/list]

Also if you're reading this but still don't own a copy of the game - rejoice! You might buy it right now with a generous [b]50%[/b] discount! Don't hesitate: all that weird quests won't complete themselves.

Hope you'll enjoy the update and thanks for playing!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26075350/6b0a7f195257bfc1ca10ab44290015e2ebe3ab2b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Winter update has come!
notes.content:
Seasons don't actually change in the world of nords. But somehow weird snowmen appeared near various settlements all over the northern realm. What is their purpose? It's up to you to discover. Also we've fixed a bunch of small bugs and corrected some typos.
Have fun playing Mad Nords and happy holidays to you all!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26075350/f25027db52349f3eed464b745845e12df65a95bf.gif[/img]

notes.title: Are You Ready to Finish Probably an Epic Quest?
notes.content:
[h1]Good news, everyone![/h1]
Finally this day has come! Mad Nords: Probably an Epic Quest came out of Early Access at last! We worked very hard to bring this release to you. And of course we hope that you'll enjoy playing our game as much as we enjoyed creating it.

[h1]Features of the full release:[/h1]
[list]
[*] a whole brand new Act 3 (including the most epic boss fight you've ever seen)
[*] a bunch of new side quests to complete
[*] lots of new locations to explore
[*] full support of Steam overlay (Steam achievements included)
[*] and of course all the bugs that were found during the early access are fixed
[/list]
